page.overview:
What is Channeling?

Channeling is the act of using the One Power, which is a fundamental force in the Wheel of Time universe. It emanates from the True Source, which consists of two complementary halves: saidin (the male half) and saidar (the female half). These halves work together and against each other, providing the driving force that turns the Wheel of Time (object) itself.

Not everyone has the ability to channel the One Power. Most people have no capacity for it, while some can be taught to varying degrees. However, a few individuals are born with "the spark," an innate inclination that leads them to touch the Source involuntarily. These untrained channelers, often referred to as wilders, may die without gaining control over their abilities due to a mysterious sickness. Wilders sometimes unknowingly use the One Power to influence events when they want something badly enough.
